definition: Simulates Haptic Suit Gaming operating for a day.
description:

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where suit rigs monitoring, gaming logistics redundancy, or impact design maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Haptic Suit Gaming Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Haptic Suit Gaming: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Haptic Suit Gaming — gaming in full-body haptic suits.

Phase 1 — Prove (suit rigs): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (gaming logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (impact design): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (hygiene): gaming hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and gamers-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
